title: Recreational fishing licence
summary: This page provides information and links for applying for, renewing, or managing a recreational fishing licence in NSW.

faqs.q: How can I apply for a recreational fishing licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a licence for different durations, including 3-day or 1-month, or 1-year or 3-year.

faqs.q: How do I renew my recreational fishing licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence using the dedicated renewal service.

faqs.q: What should I do if my licence is lost, damaged, or stolen?
faqs.a: You can replace a lost, damaged, or stolen licence using the replacement service.

faqs.q: How can I change details on my licence?
faqs.a: You can change your contact details or change the name associated with your licence.
